main.title: Kirby and the Forgotten Land
main.summary: Kirby explores a three-dimensional world, rescues Waddle Dees and uses copy abilities and Mouthful Mode to overcome its obstacles.

cards.heading: Kirby in a three-dimensional world
cards.text: Kirby and the Forgotten Land is a 2022 platform game developed by HAL Laboratory and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo Switch. Released on March 25, 2022, it is the thirteenth mainline installment in the Kirby series and the second on the Switch, as well as the first non-spinoff game in the series to be in full 3D. The player controls Kirby in an adventure through the titular forgotten land to rescue Waddle Dees kidnapped by the ferocious Beast Pack. To complete each stage and save the Waddle Dees, Kirby can use a wide range of copy abilities to help battle enemies and progress the level.

cards.heading: Copy abilities and Mouthful Mode
cards.text: Kirby and the Forgotten Land is the first platform game in the series with full 3D gameplay, where the player must guide Kirby through various different stages to save the Waddle Dees at the end. As in most Kirby games, Kirby can jump and slide as well as inhale enemies and objects which he can either spit out as projectiles or swallow to gain a copy ability. Alongside returning copy abilities, this game introduced Drill and Ranger as two new copy abilities, as well as a new "Mouthful Mode" system where Kirby can swallow and control larger objects, such as cars and vending machines. Similar to Kirby Battle Royale and Kirby and the Rainbow Curse, a second player can join in and play as Bandana Waddle Dee, who uses a spear as his main form of attack.

cards.heading: An unfamiliar world of ruins
cards.text: One day, on Kirby's home planet Planet Popstar, a dark vortex appears over Dream Land, sucking up everything in its path. Kirby is among those sucked into the vortex and finds himself in a new world that is filled with the ruins of an ancient civilization. He discovers that the Waddle Dees from Dream Land are being kidnapped by the native wildlife, the Beast Pack. Eventually, he finds the destroyed Waddle Dee Town and a chinchilla-like creature named Elfilin, who helped the Waddle Dees settle there. Upon being rescued from the Beast Pack, Elfilin explains to Kirby that he and the Waddle Dees attempted to fight back but were overwhelmed. Kirby offers to help Elfilin rescue the missing Waddle Dees, and the two set off together.

cards.heading: Making attacks readable in 3D
cards.text: Early on, play testers at Nintendo felt that the wide 3D environments made gameplay too easy as players could simply step away from enemy attacks. They suggested that enemy density be increased, but HAL Laboratory declined, saying they did not want to "torment" Kirby or prevent players from peacefully exploring the game world. To mitigate issues with depth perception, the hit detection was altered so that an attack from Kirby will hit an enemy if it looks to have done so from the player's perspective, even if the attack did not actually connect.

main.title: LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga
main.subtitle: Nine Films Rebuilt as a Galaxy to Take Apart
main.summary: LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga rebuilds nine films as a galaxy that players can explore as well as retell.

cards.heading: Three places to begin
cards.text: LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga rebuilds nine films as a galaxy that players can explore as well as retell. TT Games developed the game with Lucasfilm Games, and Warner Bros. Games published it on 5 April 2022. Players can begin with the opening episode of any of the three trilogies.

cards.heading: A galaxy between the scenes
cards.text: The galaxy map connects the familiar stories to travel between planets. A journey can include a space battle, then a landing and a choice between continuing the plot or looking for quests and puzzles. The films provide a route, but the player is also invited to stop along it.

cards.heading: Return with someone different
cards.text: Kyber Bricks reward exploration and contribute to upgrades across character classes, including Jedi, scavengers and droids. Unlockable characters make free play another way to revisit places. LEGO humour changes the tone of recognisable scenes without requiring a different saga: a serious adventure can become a family playground built from the same characters and locations.

cards.heading: Voice acting and the optional Mumble Mode
cards.text: Lego Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga does not feature a character customization tool unlike many previous Lego video games. The game includes Mumble Mode, an extra feature allowing players to switch between the game's original voice acting and having the characters mumble and grunt, akin to the style of older Lego video games.

main.title: Nintendo Switch Sports
main.subtitle: The living room becomes a sporting venue
main.summary: Nintendo Switch Sports is Nintendo's motion-controlled sports collection, released for Switch on 29 April 2022.

cards.heading: The living room becomes a sporting venue
cards.text: Nintendo Switch Sports is Nintendo's motion-controlled sports collection, released for Switch on 29 April 2022. Players use Joy-Con movements to serve, swing, bowl and compete within a shared sporting venue. Tennis and bowling return from the Wii Sports tradition alongside activities such as badminton, volleyball, football and swordplay. The collection makes the basic gesture easy to recognize, then places the contest in its timing and direction. A small movement in the room becomes a visible action that another player can immediately understand and answer.

cards.heading: A Joy-Con translates the gesture
cards.text: Each sport translates a different physical idea into a short set of controls. A bowling release, a racket swing or a guarded sword strike has its own timing, while the game handles much of the surrounding movement. Local multiplayer lets those actions form a social contest around one screen, and online matches provide further opponents. The variety makes moving between sports part of the experience: learning the next event begins with finding how a familiar real-world action has been simplified into a useful Joy-Con gesture.

cards.heading: A familiar idea in another setting
cards.text: Director Yoshikazu Yamashita led a team that began considering a Switch successor to Wii Sports after the console's release. The venue and new avatars give the collection another visual identity, while continuing updates expanded the sporting selection with golf and later basketball. Haruko Torii and Takuhiro Honda composed the music. The project carries a recognizable Nintendo idea across generations of hardware: a clear physical gesture can introduce a game quickly, while competition and the people sharing the room supply reasons to keep playing.

main.title: AI: The Somnium Files – Nirvana Initiative
main.summary: AI: The Somnium Files – Nirvana Initiative is a 2022 visual novel adventure video game developed and published by Spike Chunsoft.

cards.heading: Two investigators and the Half-Body Murders
cards.text: AI: The Somnium Files – Nirvana Initiative is a 2022 visual novel adventure video game developed and published by Spike Chunsoft. It is a sequel to AI: The Somnium Files (2019) and follows an older Mizuki Date alongside a new playable protagonist Kuruto Ryuki as they investigate the "Half-Body Murders". Gameplay is presented in both visual novel format and third-person exploration for dream investigation sequences.

cards.heading: Uchikoshi, Kozaki and a new director
cards.text: Writer Kotaro Uchikoshi returns to script the game and reunites with character designer Yūsuke Kozaki, while the first game's designer and assistant director Akira Okada took over as director.

cards.heading: A staggered international release
cards.text: The game was released for the Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, Windows, and Xbox One in June 2022 in Japan and North America, and July 2022 in Europe and Oceania.

main.title: Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes
main.subtitle: Another mercenary enters Fódlan
main.summary: Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes is Omega Force's action role-playing game, released for Nintendo Switch on 24 June 2022.

cards.heading: Another mercenary enters Fódlan
cards.text: Fire Emblem Warriors: Three Hopes is Omega Force's action role-playing game, released for Nintendo Switch on 24 June 2022. It returns to Fódlan, the setting of Fire Emblem: Three Houses, through the mercenary Shez. Choosing an alliance opens one of three campaigns in an alternative version of that world's conflict. Large battles replace the earlier game's turn-based encounters, while familiar characters, classes and relationships connect the fighting to the political divisions and personal loyalties surrounding the three nations.

cards.heading: Give orders while fighting
cards.text: The player fights directly through groups of soldiers, captures strongholds and defeats commanders, switching between selected allies as objectives change. Orders let other units attack or defend elsewhere on the map. A strong fighter is therefore only part of the plan: someone must also reach the threatened position before its defenders fall. Weapon advantages and classes influence those assignments. Conquering smaller territories provides resources and strategic options for a region's main battle, allowing preparation to change how the larger encounter begins.

cards.heading: The army returns to camp
cards.text: Between missions, the camp gives the army time to train, improve equipment and strengthen relationships through conversations and shared activities. Support between characters has practical value when they assist one another in combat. The player can spend resources to develop different classes and abilities before choosing the next mission. Three Hopes carries the ensemble of Three Houses into a more immediate form of action, keeping the wider campaign present through the people sent into battle and the preparations made when they return.
